Run code with temporary home and data directories

Source: R/with_sandbox_dir.R
with_sandbox_dir.Rd

Evaluates code with temporary home, data, cache, configuration and state directories. It is meant for examples and tests. condathis puts the environments, packages and micromamba binary that it installs into the sandbox, with every backend, not into your own directories. No Conda configuration file of yours is in reach.

Usage

with_sandbox_dir(code, .local_envir = base::parent.frame())

Arguments

code

Expression to evaluate with the temporary directories.

.local_envir

Environment code is evaluated in. Defaults to parent.frame().

Value

The value of code, visible or invisible as in code.

Details

Processes that condathis starts ignore the session's Conda settings. Code that starts micromamba or conda itself must pass --no-rc and --no-env to do the same.

The sandbox lasts exactly as long as the call. Before with_sandbox_dir() returns, also after an error in code, it does these steps in this order:

  • It restores the working directory.

  • It restores every environment variable, including ones that code set, changed or removed itself.

  • It stops the processes that use the sandbox, and their children, if they are still running. These are the processes that condathis starts for code. A process counts when its executable or one of its arguments is a path inside the sandbox. It also counts when it runs with a condathis environment or package cache inside the sandbox. Other processes started inside code keep running, for example the processx supervisor, callr sessions and mirai daemons.

  • It waits until every backend has finished its work in the R session.

  • It deletes the sandbox directories, with every environment, package and micromamba binary installed into them. When it cannot delete them, with_sandbox_dir() warns with class condathis_with_sandbox_dir_cleanup_failed. An interrupt during this cleanup leaves them in the session's temporary directory.

with_sandbox_dir() does not reset options and objects that code assigns: code runs in .local_envir, as with withr::with_envvar(). It does not change tempdir() or TMPDIR either, so files that code writes there stay.

See also

Other setup: clean_cache(), get_install_dir(), get_sys_arch(), install_micromamba(), micromamba_bin_path()

Examples

condathis::with_sandbox_dir(print(fs::path_home()))
#> /tmp/Rtmpu60vo2/condathis-sandbox-2b121c577899/home
condathis::with_sandbox_dir(print(tools::R_user_dir("condathis")))
#> [1] "/tmp/Rtmpu60vo2/condathis-sandbox-2b127290eced/data/R/condathis"
